text:
Heads up. Found a lube oil leak at Jarvie station around 3:30 pm today. Small spot on the
west side near the mainline pump. Looks like erosion under the pad-ground gave way, pipe
sagged, fitting sheared off. About 1.8 m³ on the gravel. Contained inside fence, berm held it.
Shut pump, isolated the line, started soaking up with pads. Called in spill kit, supervisor
notified. Will keep mopping up. No other issues seen.
-M. Chen, field op
